## ❓ 常见问题 / FAQ

- macOS 提示「已损坏」或「无法验证开发者」：在「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性」中点击「仍要打开」/ macOS says the app can't be verified: choose *Open Anyway* in *System Settings → Privacy & Security*
- Windows 提示「Windows 已保护你的电脑」：点击「更多信息 → 仍要运行」/ Windows SmartScreen warns about the app: choose *More info → Run anyway*
- iOS 安装包未签名：可用 AltStore、SideStore 或自己的开发者证书签名后安装 / The iOS package is unsigned: sign it with AltStore, SideStore or your own developer certificate to install it
- 使用说明：[README](https://github.com/Souitou-iop/Formigo#readme)
- 反馈问题 / Report a problem：[Issues](https://github.com/Souitou-iop/Formigo/issues)
- 更新日志 / Changelog：[CHANGELOG](https://github.com/Souitou-iop/Formigo/blob/{tag}/CHANGELOG.md)
